account.exportDescription: A JSON file of your account, profile, meals, weights, Circle, chats, notifications, feedback, billing and app activity. Uploaded photos are listed by file path.

account.signOutError: Couldn't sign out. Please try again.
account.deleteDescription: Permanently remove your account and everything in it.
account.deleteConsequence: This removes your profile, every meal you've logged, and your weight history. There is no undo.
account.deleteSubscriptionWarning: Deleting your Kallo account does not cancel an active subscription. Cancel it first — in the App Store, Google Play, or the billing portal you purchased through on the web — to prevent future charges. You can still delete immediately.
account.deleteError: Could not delete your account. Please try again.
